-- Integer square root: the largest r with r * r <= n.
-- The upper-bound check is written as n - out * out <= 2 * out,
-- which is equivalent to (out + 1) * (out + 1) > n but cannot overflow.

isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and n - out * out <= 2 * out
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(15) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var r = 0
  while (r + 1) * (r + 1) <= n
    r += 1
  r

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(15) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(17) == 4
